asset.name: Public records request
asset.description: A public records request (FOIA, OIA, state public records acts) from its form to release: statutory deadline and SLA, acknowledgement, records gathering, automated redaction of video, photos, audio and documents, an exemptions log, legal approval, and a release package with cover letter, or a denial, no-records or extension letter.

config.task_description:
{{form.requester_name}} <{{form.requester_email}}> asks under {{form.jurisdiction}} for:

{{form.records_sought}}

Dates {{date_range}} · location {{form.location}} · incident {{form.incident_ref}}

Search your systems and attach every responsive record: body-worn camera or CCTV video, photos, interview audio and documents. Attached originals stay restricted to this request; only redacted copies can be released.

Deadline {{due_date}} ({{deadline_days}} {{day_type}}; {{legal_basis}}).

fields.label: Body-worn camera / CCTV video
fields.help_text: One clip per request (MP4 or MOV).

fields.label: Documents (statement, report)
fields.help_text: Word, PDF or text: personal information is found for review and redacted after approval.

config.task_description:
{{form.jurisdiction}} request from {{form.requester_name}} for: {{form.records_sought}}

Automated redaction is an aid, not a decision: compare each redacted copy with the original before you approve. Restricted: originals open only for people with access to this request; they are never attached to emails or released.

  • Video: original {{evidence.bodycam_video[0].name}} → redacted {{redacted_video_file.name}} ({{redacted_video_count}} regions blurred, {{=COUNT(redacted_video.audio_segments)}} speech segment(s) bleeped)
  • Photos: {{=COUNT(redacted_photos)}} redacted, {{=SUM(PLUCK(redacted_photos, "regions"))}} regions; first: original {{evidence.photos[0].name}} → redacted {{redacted_photos[0].file.name}}
  • Interview audio: original {{evidence.interview_audio[0].name}} → bleeped {{redacted_audio_file.name}}; redacted transcript {{redacted_transcript_file.name}}
  • Document: {{evidence.documents[0].name}}: {{doc_findings_count}} items of personal information found (redacted when you approve)

Proposed exemptions: {{privacy_exemption}} (privacy), {{law_enforcement_exemption}} (law enforcement). Deadline {{due_date}}.

fields.label: Reasons (used in the letter)
